name: Alistair McGregor
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport catering began unexpectedly. After years running a traditional Scottish bakery in his hometown, a chance encounter with a Team Penske engineer led to a trial at a local race event. His haggis-stuffed pies were a hit, and he was offered a full-time role. Alistair believes in providing comforting, high-quality meals to the team, seeing it as crucial for morale and performance. He's known for his meticulous planning, ensuring dietary needs are met and that everyone feels at home, even on the road.

His dedication to quality and understanding of the unique demands of a racing team set him apart. He understands that a well-fed crew is a focused crew. Beyond the traditional Scottish fare, Alistair prides himself on adapting his menus to cater to international tastes, always adding a touch of Scottish hospitality. He is also working on sustainable catering practices, reducing waste and sourcing local ingredients where possible.

physical.description: Alistair is a stout man with a friendly face and a perpetual twinkle in his eye.

quirks: Insists on playing bagpipe music softly during meal prep.
Always has a stash of shortbread for emergencies.
Refers to the team as 'the family'.
